verdict.rationale: Gitea documents having an API for extensibility (gitea-docs-4) but provides no evidence of API versioning scheme or a documented deprecation policy—OpenAPI/spec probes 404'd (gitea-probe-2) and no llms.txt exists (gitea-probe-1). Community evidence directly undercuts the story: users complain about breaking changes (e.g., 1.17.0 reserving usernames) being merged with maintainers allegedly dismissing concerns (gitea-comm-17), suggesting no reliable deprecation process.
